llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: no verifiable company information, ambiguous contact references (no business phone/email/address), urgent promotional language, thin navigation structure, and attempted brand mimicry (Martina Textor + Marc Cain) without evidence of official association. No evidence of standard payment or privacy policy details, and the copyright year (2025) matches the current year, suggesting a recent and likely fraudulent setup.
